title: Gluing given local coefficient models after a common finite enlargement
statement: Let T and X be schemes, X quasi-separated, f:X→T any morphism, ℓ prime, E a finite intermediate coefficient field [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], and U_i→X a finite affine pro-etale cover [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. For an internal module M over f⁻¹Ω_T [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], suppose finitely presented modules N_i over the restrictions of f⁻¹E_T are given, together with isomorphisms of their Ω-extensions to M restricted to U_i. Then some finite F containing E admits an internal f⁻¹F_T-module P whose restriction to U_i is isomorphic to F⊗_E N_i and whose Ω-extension is isomorphic to M. The local isomorphisms are part of the conclusion; local finite presentation of P is not assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Descend the supplied local models to compatible monomorphisms into the restriction of M at one common finite coefficient field F. This retains the fact that their scalar adjoints are isomorphisms.

Glue these compatible local submodules using the underlying abelian kernel construction and the proved lifting of its module action. Retain the local module isomorphisms and the commutation equations with the global inclusion.

Transpose the global inclusion by extension/restriction adjunction. Prove the local adjunction comparison using the existing pullbackExtendScalarsIso, adjoint uniqueness, and unit naturality; thus each restriction is an isomorphism.

Weakly etale inverse image agrees with restriction. Covering-sieve isomorphism detection proves the global scalar-extension map invertible; module forgetfulness reflects isomorphisms. This argument includes the empty cover.

proof_origin.note: A3: actual kernel construction, local factorization, lifted action, and adjunction plus cover-detection proof. Only finite coefficient comparisons remain unproved; all compatible-subobject gluing and local quotient vanishing are proved.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteCoefficient_gluing_of_local_models
    (T X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (f : X ⟶ T) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)))
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
    (U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (hfinite : Finite U.I₀) (haffine : ∀ i, IsAffine (U.X i))
    (N : ∀ i, Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U.X i)) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))))
    (hN : ∀ i, Mod.IsFinitelyPresented
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))) (N i))
    (e : ∀ i, Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E)))).obj
          (N i) ≅
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))).obj M)) :
    ∃ (F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (hEF : E ≤ F)
      (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ F))),
      (∀ i, Nonempty (
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ F))).obj P ≅
        (Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjMap T ℓ hEF)))).obj (N i))) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ F))).obj P ≅ M)
